title: The affine-space trace is an isomorphism
statement:
Let $N\geq1$, let $A$ be a finite commutative ring with $NA=0$, and let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme] (one admitting a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings) on which $N$ is invertible. Work in the ordinary derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Use the ordinary etale finite Tate sheaves of [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback]: $A_T(1)=\mu_{N,T}\otimes_{\mathbf Z/N}A_T$, their tensor powers $A_T(d)$, and $K(d)=K\otimes_A^LA_T(d)$. Let $d\geq0$ and let $p_d:\mathbf A^d_S\to S$ be the projection [def-sbc-affine-space], with compact-support direct image [def-amb-etale-compact-support]. The explicit affine-space adjunction is the following one. For $d=1$, use the standard compactification $j:\mathbf A^1_S\hookrightarrow P=\mathbf P^1_S$, $q:P\to S$, and compose $Dj_!\dashv j^*$ [prop-weil-open-closed-recollement-adjunctions] with the projective-line adjunction of [lem-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-adjunction], normalized by the trace $t_q$ of [def-amb-p1-trace]. For general $d$, let $F_d$ be the ordered composite of these affine-line compact-support functors in the coordinate tower, and form its composite adjunction using [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction]; for $d=0$ use the identity adjunction. Its right adjoint is $G_d=p_d^*(-)(d)[2d]$. On bounded-below inputs identify $F_d$ with $Rp_{d!}$ by the coherent compact-support composition isomorphisms [lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons]. Let
$$t_{p_d}:Rp_{d!}A_{\mathbf A^d_S}(d)[2d]\longrightarrow A_S$$
be the counit of $F_d\dashv G_d$ at $A_S$, with its source identified by this bounded-below comparison. Then $t_{p_d}$ is an isomorphism. For every morphism $g:S'\to S$ of Noetherian schemes, put $X'=\mathbf A^d_{S'}$, with projections $p'_d:X'\to S'$ and $g':X'\to\mathbf A^d_S$. Under the canonical Tate pullback identifications, and the compact-support exchange $C_{d,g}:g^*Rp_{d!}\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp'_{d!}g'^*$ of [thm-cbc-finite-torsion] on the indicated bounded-below input, the actual maps satisfy
$$t_{p'_d}\circ C_{d,g,A(d)[2d]}=g^*t_{p_d}.$$
Thus the counit trace is compatible with arbitrary change of Noetherian base.

proof.text: Obtain the normalized projective-line transport and data from exists_ordinaryFiniteP1Adjunction.
Use the coordinate right-functor normal form and boundedness calculation.

Induct on d for every coefficient complex K. At zero the counit is identity. At a successor the composite counit is the preceding left functor applied to the affine-line counit, followed by the preceding counit. Both are invertible.

Apply the arbitrary-coefficient tower counit base-change square at the constant complex. Postcompose with the canonical constant-object pullback isomorphism and apply counit naturality to obtain exactly the constant-coefficient trace equality.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affineSpaceTopTrace (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0) :
    ∃ (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
      (D : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (hT : IsUnit (N : Γ(T, ⊤))),
        OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum A N hA t T hT),
      OrdinaryFiniteP1BaseChange A N hA t D ∧
      ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (d : ℕ),
        Nonempty (affineTraceRight A N hA S d ≅
          ordinaryFinitePullback A (affineTraceProjection S d) ⋙
            derivedTensorRight (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (affineTraceTower S d)
              ((_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
                (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateSheaf A N (affineTraceTower S d) hA (d : ℤ))) ⋙
            shiftFunctor _ (2 * (d : ℤ))) ∧
        _root_.DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus
          ((affineTraceRight A N hA S d).obj (ordinaryFiniteUnit A S)) ∧
        IsIso (affineTraceCounit A N hA t D S hS d) ∧
        ∀ (S' : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S'] (g : S' ⟶ S),
          affineTraceExchange A g d
              ((affineTraceRight A N hA S d).obj (ordinaryFiniteUnit A S)) ≫
            (affineTraceLeft A S' d).map
              ((affineTraceRightBaseChange A N hA t g hS d
                (ordinaryFiniteUnit A S)).hom ≫
                (affineTraceRight A N hA S' d).map (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A g).hom) ≫
            affineTraceCounit A N hA t D S' (affineTracePullbackInvertible N g hS) d =
          (ordinaryFinitePullback A g).map (affineTraceCounit A N hA t D S hS d) ≫
            (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A g).hom
lean.note: The affine d-space is represented by its coordinate tower, with identity as the zeroth stage. Both adjunctions and exchanges are literal composites. The existing normalized projective-line datum determines the trace; no independent map or orientation is chosen. The canonical D+ comparison and its ambient restriction compatibility are real constructions.
